text: Privacy as exact combinatorics on synthetic data: k-anonymity over all 65536 four-row tables (largest k = 1, 2, 4 for 64800, 720, 16 tables) with the least-generalization search equal to brute force on every table; the exact distribution of unique individuals matches E = n(1-1/D)^(n-1) for 30 (n, D) pairs; randomized response meets epsilon-DP with ratio p/(1-p) over all 98 neighbour pairs, and sequential composition adds exactly; Bell and Stirling numbers by enumeration. Definitions on synthetic data, not a guarantee for any real release.
Bell numbers: equality patterns (set partitions) of n table rows, n=1..8
4-row tables over 2 attributes x 4 values by least generalization height reaching k=2, h=0..4, then total
Stirling numbers of the second kind S(5,k), k=1..5, padded: rows of 5 records falling into k distinct values; then S(5,k) sum check
